description: This file defines the SaveProjectController class within the OrangeHRM system's Time plugin. It manages the rendering and authorization logic for saving or editing a project, including handling pre-render setup such as initializing UI components and permissions. It interacts with project services and data access objects, particularly related to project activities within time tracking.

classes.name: SaveProjectController
classes.description: Controller responsible for handling save and edit project functionalities within the OrangeHRM time management module, including permission handling and pre-render setup.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the component and permissions before rendering, based on whether a project ID is provided in the request.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specified project, throwing an exception if the project does not exist.
